description: A photograph depicting burnt scrubland in Southern Italy, captured on 2018-07-29. The foreground and midground are dominated by numerous charred, bare shrubs and small bushes, indicating recent fire damage. The ground consists of dry, reddish-brown earth mixed with rocks and patches of sparse, light green vegetation. In the background, rolling hills with some green vegetation are visible under a clear, bright blue sky, with a distant mountain range on the horizon. The image credit is CCME 2018, provided under Copernicus by the European Union and ESA. A small watermark in the bottom left corner of the image reads "© Editorial Lucas 2020". This photograph serves as an example of the "Burnt areas (except burnt forest)" category, often classified as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 6.3.2 in land monitoring services.
